dialogues.speaker: Reza
dialogues.text: Thanks for asking, but some of the problems go a long way back and can't be easily changed.

dialogues.speaker: Reza
dialogues.text: According to new Sumeru regulations, foreign trading is limited to Port Ormos, but a lot of people have been doing business in the city for a long time...

dialogues.speaker: Reza
dialogues.text: It's just too hard to dissuade them from the old way of trading.

dialogues.speaker: Reza
dialogues.text: So it's not that we don't want to solve certain issues, but that we just don't know how.
